source_pr_title: Use /env as homeMountPath in openshift-devenv recipe
author: codacy-production
body:
<sub>:red_circle: HIGH RISK</sub>

The lifecycle script hardcodes the mount path to `/env` for `PASEO_HOME`, `HOME`, and the log file path. This ignores the `homeMountPath` variable (defined on line 113) which can be overridden via props. If a user provides a custom path, the lifecycle script will point to the wrong location. Refactor `buildLifecycle` to accept `homeMountPath` as a parameter and use it dynamically to replace these hardcoded strings.
<!-- e34d5167-b092-49eb-b8c8-33859ab00079 -->

Suggestion: The removal of the default command `['devenv', 'up']` shifts responsibility to the container image's default `ENTRYPOINT`. Ensure that all images used with this recipe are configured to start the environment automatically, otherwise the deployment will fail to initialize.

source_pr_title: Use /env as homeMountPath in openshift-devenv recipe
author: codacy-production
body:
<sub>:white_circle: LOW RISK</sub>

Nitpick: The default value for `homeMountPath` is already handled in `computeValues` (line 66), making the nullish coalescing operator redundant here.

```suggestion
      [{ name: 'workspace-state', mountPath: values.homeMountPath }];
```
<!-- e34d5167-b092-49eb-b8c8-33859ab00079 -->
